The '''Senate Cafe'''<ref name="script">{{Disney|subdomain=assets.debut|url=documents/Andor%20209%20--%20POST%20FINAL%20--%203.3.24%5B1%5D.pdf|text=Episode #209 "Welcome To The Rebellion" Script|format=PDF}}</ref> was a cafe located within the [[Imperial Senate]] [[Senate arcade building|arcade building]].<ref name="Welcome" /> In [[2 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{AndorDate|209}}</ref> a team assembled by [[Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa]]'s people, composed of [[Selko]], [[Charval]], and [[Beska]]—the latter being an [[Imperial Security Bureau]] plant—got together at the Senate Cafe arcade to coordinate Senator [[Mon Mothma]]'s extraction after her planned speech denouncing the [[Galactic Empire]] and its [[Galactic Emperor|Emperor]] [[Darth Sidious|Palpatine]] in the wake of the [[Ghorman Massacre]].<ref name="Welcome" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Senate Cafe appeared in "[[Welcome to the Rebellion]]," the ninth episode of the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the television series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'' released on [[Disney+]]<ref name="Welcome" /> on [[May 6]], [[2025]].<ref name="Trailer News">{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}}</ref> It was identified by name in the script for the episode, published on [[Disney Debut]].<ref name="script" />
